routine: 단어 5분(예문 소리 내어 2번) → 패턴 5분(뼈대에 내 문장 넣기) → 위를 가리고 문제 3분 → 복습 2분 → 오늘 쓸 표현 1개 골라 실제 메일에 쓰기

review.title: 복습 (11/26·11/20 표현 + 오답 2개), 영어로 먼저 써 보기

items.answer: Please let me know what caused ~ and when ~ will ~.

items.prompt: (자료·숫자·번역이) 정확한 — correct 대신: Please check that the Vietnamese text is ____.
타당한 이유를 대다 — explain why 대신: Please ____ the purchase of 3 units.

cover_practice.prompt: 잠정적인: The t________ date for the fire drill is Dec 10.
오래돼 안 쓰는: Please list the o_______ fabric that we can dispose of.
실제로: Please count the rolls that are p_________ on the rack, not only in the system.
유효한: Is this work permit still v____ after the job change?
메일에는 첨부가 3개라고 되어 있는데, 저는 2개만 보입니다. (주어·동사 넣기)
cover_practice.answer: Your mail mentions three attachments, but I only see two.

cover_practice.prompt: 제가 초안을 만들어서 금요일 전에 같이 검토하겠습니다. (주어·동사 넣기)
cover_practice.answer: I'll make the draft and go over it with you before Friday.

words.meaning: 잠정적인, 아직 바뀔 수 있는 — may change 대신
words.example: Supplier A is our tentative choice, because another quote may be better.
words.collocations: a tentative date / tentatively scheduled for Dec 10

words.meaning: (더 이상 안 쓰는) 오래된, 쓸모없어진 — old / finished 대신
words.example: Please note if the obsolete fabric from old buyers can still be used.
Please check if the fabric is physically in the warehouse.
words.collocations: physically count / physically check the stock

words.example: Please confirm whether this receipt is valid proof of our environmental registration.

patterns.pattern: Your mail mentions ~, but I only see ~.
patterns.meaning: 메일에는 ~라고 되어 있는데, 제게는 ~만 보입니다 (메일 내용과 첨부·숫자가 안 맞을 때 탓하지 않고 짚기)
patterns.skeleton: Your mail mentions + [명사], but + I + only see + [명사]
patterns.email: Your mail mentions three suppliers, but I only see two in the file.
patterns.spoken: You said three, but I only see two.

patterns.meaning: 단지 ~하려고 ~하지는 마세요 (숫자·기한 맞추려고 규정을 어기지 않게)
patterns.email: Please do not keep the waste longer than allowed just to stay under the weight limit.
patterns.spoken: Don't hold it longer just to hit the limit.

patterns.pattern: I'll ~ and go over it with you before ~.
patterns.meaning: ~해서 ~ 전에 같이 검토하겠습니다 (확정 전에 담당자와 먼저 맞춰 볼 때)
patterns.skeleton: I'll + [동사] + and go over it with you before + [날짜 / 주어+동사]
patterns.email: I'll prepare a proposal for the evaluation amounts and go over it with you before Dec 5.
patterns.spoken: I'll draft it, and we can go over it together.

source: 11/26 보낸 메일(퓨징기 벨트 견적 회신, QR 원단 재고 바이어 확인, 환경 등록 증빙, 폐기물 계약 갱신, 2027 급여 평가 일정)에서 고름. 받은 메일은 따로 읽지 않음.
